structured_output.summary: The diff implements Object.isSealed as the spec describes. Step 1 returns true when the argument is not an Object. Step 2 propagates the result of TestIntegrityLevel(obj, sealed) with `?`. The helper is delegated to the existing ops::test_integrity_level rather than re-implemented, and the change stays in the one in-scope file. The only other edits are renaming the unused `this`/`new_target` parameters to underscore-prefixed names and removing the `let _ = ...` placeholder, which the implementation requires. The remaining test262 failures come from Proxy [[IsExtensible]] being unimplemented in the engine, which throws the not-implemented error as the ticket requires. I did not inspect ops::test_integrity_level itself, since it is outside the diff; the build passing suggests it exists.
